title: Coordinatewise xor evaluated at a coordinate
statement: Let $y, z \colon \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Bool}$ be two $n$-bit Boolean inputs, and let $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ be a coordinate. Then the $i$-th coordinate of their coordinatewise xor equals the xor of their individual $i$-th coordinates, namely $y_i \oplus z_i$.
hypotheses_covered: y, z are n-bit Boolean inputs
i is a coordinate in Fin n
replaced:
For all $y, z : \mathrm{BoolInput}\,n$ and $i : \mathrm{Fin}\,n$,
$\mathrm{xorInput}(y, z)(i) = y_i \oplus z_i$.
